policy: Kotowa vocabulary and grammar data take precedence. Exact reading/sense and explicit compound/orthographic links are retained. Unmatched teaching units have no asserted JLPT level.
review_scope: All source-to-canonical associations, category/group decisions and levels were checked; canonical meanings/examples/explanations take precedence and are inherited from the existing Kotowa review.
All retained supplemental Chinese explanations, usage constructions, kana tips and unmatched example pairs were read and reviewed by Codex. This is AI review, not independent human review.
Removed duplicate harau. Corrected tsumikasaneru to ichidan in addition to the five canonical group conflicts.
Replaced inaccurate Chinese sound-alikes with articulation/composition tips; retained all 104 hiragana progress IDs.
Legacy grammar explanations and examples were replaced with linked canonical grammar content. Legacy verb examples were replaced with canonical examples where available.

No claim is made to have independently re-reviewed every existing Kotowa example. Quiz distractors are generated from these curricula and checked structurally; they are not a proficiency certification.
